The '''All Terrain Heavy Enforcer (AT-HE)''' was a model of heavy combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]]<ref name="AT-HE" /> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Developed on the successes<ref name="AT-HE" /> and shortcomings of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering's]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]], its long [[Limb/Legends|legs]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> elevated the walker's hull above the reach of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and gave its<ref name="AotC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]<ref name="AT-HE" /> a greater field of fire.<ref name="AotC:ICS" /> However, the walker's narrow feet made it more prone to sinking in soft soil than KDY's [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]], as the large surface area of its wheels helped to reduce ground pressure.<ref name="RotS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Introduced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="AT-AT">{{CSWECite|I|22|All Terrain Armored Transport (AT-AT walker)}}</ref> the AT-HE was utilized by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was a forerunner of KDY's [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> which, while similar in appearance, was smaller and equipped with less powerful [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannons.<ref name="AT-HE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The All Terrain Heavy Enforcer was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2002]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="AotC:ICS" />
